competitors.name: 7-Eleven / Speedway
competitors.action: C-Store Dive reported that 7-Eleven named Ibotta its exclusive third-party provider of CPG digital offers across the 7-Eleven, 7Now and Speedway apps, excluding age-restricted items. The partnership is expected to go live in the fall and gives CPG brands access to more than 100 million loyalty members with grocery-style offer accountability.

competitors.name: Grocery retailers / FMI
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported FMI's first Power of Beverage report showing food-retail beverage sales reached $295 billion in 2025, up 3%, with nonalcoholic drinks up 5% to $221 billion. FMI said retailers should merchandise around need states such as hydration, protein, digestive support and relaxation rather than only traditional beverage segments.

competitors.name: Save A Lot
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported that Save A Lot opened its second Save A Lot y Mas Hispanic-format store in St. Louis, operated by Leevers Supermarkets. The format emphasizes fresh Hispanic produce, specialty meats, ready-to-cook marinated options, local bakery items, Spanish-language promotions and a value positioning tailored to multicultural grocery demand.

trends.topic: C-store CPG promotions becoming more grocery-like
trends.magnitude: 7-Eleven/Ibotta will reach more than 100 million 7-Eleven and Speedway loyalty members
trends.context: Convenience retailers are adding manufacturer-funded digital offers and measurement standards that resemble grocery and delivery. Frozen and prepared-food brands should expect more retail-media and offer discipline even outside supermarkets.

trends.magnitude: FMI reported food-retail beverage sales of $295B in 2025, with nonalcoholic drinks up 5% to $221B
trends.context: Retailers are testing category organization around functional outcomes instead of legacy shelf sets. The same logic can affect premium frozen: product pages and shelf tags need clear occasion, nutrition and preparation cues.

trends.magnitude: Save A Lot opened a second Save A Lot y Mas store roughly one year after the first location
trends.context: Discount grocers are using localized assortment, language and prepared-food cues to court specific communities. Regional brands should treat cultural relevance and neighborhood fit as retail execution issues, not just marketing themes.
